warning: Bundled OFFLINE sample library. These entries are generated tones plus documentation placeholders used when the Nuxel bridge does not answer (VM, desktop browser, or a handset without the host running). They are NOT a scan of your device storage. Every entry is labelled `source: sample` in the UI, and the tones are real, decodable 8 kHz PCM WAV files, so playback, seeking and the transport controls can be exercised end to end offline.
device_note: On the S10+ the audio route is ALSA card `beyond-madera` (Exynos 9820); audibility is an owner test (manual proof area 41).
